baseRunTimeSec.note: Added to every segment run time

runTimeNoiseStddev.note: Standard deviation of run time noise

ridersPerMinute.note: Base rider arrival rate at most platforms

downtownMultiplier.note: Rider rate multiplier for downtown stations

rushMultiplier.note: Rider rate multiplier in rush scenario

baseDwellSec.note: Minimum dwell time at a platform

dwellPerRider.note: Dwell time added per rider waiting

maxDwellSec.note: Maximum dwell time at a platform

terminalLayoverSec.note: Minimum time at Alewife and Braintree

minGapSec.note: Minimum seconds between departures at a platform

maxHoldSec.note: Maximum hold time at a control station

closeFactor.note: Gap threshold for close state, as fraction of H

bunchedFactor.note: Gap threshold for bunched state, as fraction of H

numTrains.note: Number of trains in late and rush scenarios

latenessSec.note: How far behind one train starts in late scenario

initialLoadFactor.note: Each train starts with this × average boardings per stop
